result.caveats: (1) Money caliber statement is algebraic (qty × ΔP ≡ notional × (P1/P0 − 1)) and empirically supported by: raw-kline identity (compounded reproduces close ratio to f16 precision; Σ-simple does not), the twin (positions × Δmid) vs paper correlations, and the daily equity reconciliation (four clean days within ±$41 ≈ ±10 bps of gross; corr 0.94). The daily test cannot distinguish Σ-simple from compounded at the book level — their book-level difference (≈ −1.1 ± 6.4 bps/anchor live, ≈ 0 ± 3-5 bps/anchor on 2024-26 legs) is far below the twin/paper noise (sd ≈ 21-33 bps/anchor); the discriminating evidence is the name-level identity, not the book. (2) The pod's y4old (and the bundle/meta y4 that trained the king rank target and feeds bundle leg_returns) uses the window [N−5m, N+3h55m] (one bar earlier than y4s); the live seat uses (N, N+4h]. Both are Σ-simple; window shift adds noise (std 5.4 vs 3.3 bps/anchor at leg level) but ~zero mean. (3) dlw_targets.npz was built on jpline from a different cache file (meta_json); jpline was not contacted (down per brief); equivalence rests on the bitwise recompute against the pod ext cache (99.989% exact). (4) Live twin timing: positions from the post-anchor read (~N+44 min) valued from mids at the pricing moment (~N+24 min) to the next pricing moment; the paper window is (N, N+4h] on 5m closes — hence corr ≈ 0.77 and slope 0.85 rather than 1; the venue-aligned paper window narrows the mean gap to −0.5 bps. Transfers between the last nav row (~20:44Z) and 24:00Z would be missed by external_flow (none observed). (6) Fund leg computed with the positive sign of f_fund_ema_v1 exactly as pod_export_bundle_v3.py L102 (no M1 base-rank; that is the live-only variant, shadow_loop_v3 L471). (7) scipy.stats.rankdata (scipy 1.17.1 already in /workspace/venv) used for ranks to match the production definition; numpy 2.4.6. (8) Cache ret5 is float16 and clipped ±0.3 (pod_merge_cache_ext.py L27; shadow_loop_v3 clipch L253) — the compounded cache return deviates from the exchange price ratio by ≤1.2e-5 for that reason.
